_comment: Every knob the patcher run has, with its default and the reason for it.
Copy this, edit, pass with --config. `run_patcher.py --check` validates it
and the tree and the toolchain without spending a token; run that first.
Paths may be absolute or relative to the repository root.

inputs._comment: Both are validated and scrubbed by blind_guard before any prompt is built. A forbidden value pattern fails the run here, before a token is spent.

_comment: base_tree is copied to work_tree once, at run start, and never patched in place.
node_modules is a shared install symlinked into work_tree: it is ~1GB and copying
it per run is wasteful, but it must NOT be inside the diff or the tree hash.
The copy is a real copy, not hardlinks - an in-place write through a hardlink
would corrupt the base tree every later run is copied from.
allowed_tools deliberately omits WebFetch and WebSearch. Upstream Juice Shop is
the answer key; a single fetch of it would end the run's validity.
A 429 is 'not yet', not 'could not': the runner blocks and re-probes rather than
recording a $0 one-turn failure that would later read as a reasoning result.
task_concurrency 1 means one cumulative tree, tasks in order. That is what makes
'one fixed codebase' meaningful and lets a later task detect damage an earlier one
caused. Raising it splits the tree and trades that guarantee for wall-clock.
reconcile_rounds 4 is a starting guess. The right number is whatever the
rounds_to_green distribution turns out to be, which needs a run.
on_exhausted: revert | keep_best | keep_if_workflow_intact.
revert                  - roll the task back, record `abandoned`. Trades a possible
remediation credit for a guaranteed non-regression, and
keeps damage out of the tasks that follow. Default.
keep_best               - bank the best round, record `partial`. Maximises axis A.
keep_if_workflow_intact - keep when the workflow is green even if the probe never
flipped; revert when the workflow is red. Never ships
known damage, still banks uncertain fixes.
require_probe false: an unprovable probe is a limit of the agent, not evidence of a
non-bug - the report is stipulated accurate. Flip once probe_coverage is known.
regression_net: related | own_only | full_suite_per_task.
final_full_suite: one whole-suite gate after all tasks, with a bounded repair loop.
Collateral damage shows up where nobody predicted it, so the last net is global.
{file} is substituted. The runner executes these itself - the agent's claim that it
ran them is collected as an attestation and never used as a gate.
test/server/**/*.unit.test.ts uses the server env; test/api/**/*.test.ts uses the api
env. testmap.py picks the right one per file.
run_dir holds state.json, per-task artefacts, transcripts, diffs and the final
patcher-report.json. It lives OUTSIDE the repository: transcripts and per-task
records pair a bug id with a file and a line, which the publishing rule does not
allow in a committed artefact.
Appended to the built-in deny sets in hooks/sandbox_guard.py. The built-ins already
cover out-of-tree access, writes under test/ and cypress/, network egress, and the
answer-key pattern set. Add here; do not weaken there.
